title: connector-kit (vendored source for private-app connectors)
description: Zero-dependency source kit that recipes and the app scaffold vendor: ConnectorAuthClient (client_secret_basic, client_secret_post, private_key_jwt; early refresh), WebhookReceiver (Content-Digest, RFC 9421, created window, published-key lookup, replay guard) and ApiClient (Idempotency-Key reused on retry, Retry-After, bounded backoff, cursor pagination) with one error model.
